data.one_liner: Flutter widget package for displaying and editing vertical Mongolian text.
data.what_it_does: Provides vertical equivalents of standard Flutter text, input, list, menu, and dialog widgets designed specifically for traditional Mongolian vertical text. It handles line wrapping, character rotation for emojis and CJK characters, and text editing.
use_when: You need to display traditional Mongolian vertical text in a Flutter app.
You need vertical input fields, list tiles, popups, or dialogs for Mongolian script.
avoid_when: You only need standard horizontal text display.
You cannot include custom Mongolian font assets with your project.
strengths: Comprehensive collection of vertical widgets matching standard Flutter components.
Supports mobile, web, and desktop platforms.
Correctly rotates emojis and CJK characters for vertical orientation.
weaknesses: Requires you to manually add and configure a custom Mongolian font asset.
Known minor bug in MongolTextField for maxLines: null.
data.setup_notes: Add a Mongolian font asset to your project and set the default fontFamily in your app theme.
data.minimal_example: MongolText('ᠨᠢᠭᠡ ᠬᠣᠶᠠᠷ ᠭᠤᠷᠪᠠ ᠳᠦᠷᠪᠡ ᠲᠠᠪᠤ ᠵᠢᠷᠭᠤᠭ᠎ᠠ ᠳᠣᠯᠣᠭ᠎ᠠ ᠨᠠᠢᠮᠠ ᠶᠢᠰᠦ ᠠᠷᠪᠠ');
